# Daily Report — 2026-10-01

## Task Completed
Added `list_software_assets` tool: queries the `alm_asset` table with a hard-coded
`model_category.nameLIKESoftware` filter so callers always get software-category records.
Supports optional filters for `display_name`, `install_status`, `assigned_to`,
`asset_tag`, `software_name` (substring match on `model.name`), and a raw
`query` escape hatch. Full pagination with `has_more`/`next_offset`. Registered
in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `config/tool_packages.yaml` (service_desk,
system_administrator, and full packages).
